_note: Labelled corpus for the matcher eval. Each entry pairs a synthetic body with the set of watchlist keywords that SHOULD match. The eval treats every (body, keyword) cell as binary: did the matcher fire on it? expected to? The corpus deliberately mixes exact-match cases, near-miss cases that fuzzy should catch, and noise cases (bodies with no expected matches) so precision and recall are both measurable.
